name: Jelana
overview: Cached Jellyfin analytics, restricted to administrators. Requires Jellyfin 12 and Playback Reporting.
description: Administrator-only fork of Jelana. Every /Jelana endpoint requires an admin; no anonymous endpoints and no token handling in URLs or browser storage. Playback Reporting is read only during scheduled cache refreshes.

versions.changelog: Administrator-only: all endpoints require Jellyfin's RequiresElevation policy. Removed anonymous endpoints, the standalone page, JS Injector menu loader and all access-token handling. Inlined assets, no-store API responses, whitelisted SQL fragments.
